# Private Gist

Create a GitHub Gist only when the participant asks for one or approves the
contents. It must always be private. Before creating it, show the proposed
files and confirm that they contain no credentials, personal data, proprietary
data, or unreviewed secrets. Use descriptive filenames and summarize the
private Gist purpose without publishing its contents elsewhere.

Never create a Gist from this template repository unless the participant
explicitly authorizes it in their copied exercise repository.
